name: Memory Shard
description: Manual side note card: compresses recent history into a compact, resumable memory shard — a token-lean take on the Memory Sharding quick reply, with the latest shard fed back into context
author: SillyBunny
prompt:
Compress the recent conversation into a compact memory shard the story could be resumed from if all other history were lost. When [Your previous notes] contains earlier shards, build on them: carry forward still-relevant facts, update what changed, drop what resolved, and do not repeat unchanged entries verbatim. Identify emotional peaks first and map causal chains backward from them; preserve high-impact material in more detail and compress or omit what can be inferred.

Output exactly these sections, using terse pipe-delimited lines and keywords instead of prose:

## TIMELINE
Numbered anchor phrases with location, oldest to newest. All other sections reference these numbers.

## CHARACTERS
Name|role|3-5 trait keywords|status

## RELATIONSHIPS
A -> B: dimension=0-100 values | one-line note. 50 is neutral baseline; list only dimensions that matter (trust, intimacy, tension, hostility, affection, dependency).

## EVENTS
N. action -> consequence -> outcome, weight 1-5. Weight 5 means a permanent change to a character, relationship, or world state and must keep its key details; omit weight-1 filler entirely.

## DIALOGUE KEYS
Timeline#. "exact quote" --Speaker (context). Only confessions, threats, promises, reveals, and voice-defining lines.

## THREADS
Unresolved hooks and planted callbacks: thread|status (unresolved, developing, urgent)|note

## NOW
Location, time, characters present, situation, pending actions, mood, physical state.

Mark uncertain facts with (?). Never invent events, quotes, or details. Plain text only, no code fences.
